name: Cultural Diversity
overview: Scripture reveals that all humanity originated from one blood and language before God diversified nations and their dwellings (Genesis 11:1; Acts 17:26). Despite cultural distinctions, God calls all who join themselves to Him, including strangers, to serve and uphold His covenant (Isaiah 56:6). The gospel transcends ethnic boundaries, offering salvation to both Jew and Gentile alike (Romans 1:16). Believers are exhorted to maintain humility and unity, accepting one another without judgment, reflecting Christlike love across diverse backgrounds (Romans 12:16; Romans 14:1).
